caseName: Queens Land & Title Co. v. Kings County Trust Co.
caseNameFull: Queens Land & Title Company v. Kings County Trust Company
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Eastern District of New York.
attorneys: Mr. William G. Cooke for appellants., Mr. George E. Brower for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Affirmed with costs upon the authority of Farrell v. O’Brien, 199 U. S. 89, 100; Goodrich v. Ferris, 214 U. S. 71, 79; Brolan v. United States, 236 U. S. 216, 218; Sugarman v. United States, 249 U. S. 182, 184. And see Blumenstock Bros. Advertising Agency v. Curtis Publishing Co., this day decided, ante, 436.
